articles.headline: Britain warns another terror attack is 'highly likely' within 6 months after London stabbing
articles.description: Britain raised its national terror threat level to severe after two people were stabbed in an antisemitic attack in London's Golders Green neighborhood.

articles.headline: Israel defense chief warns strikes on Iran could resume soon, signals campaign not over
articles.description: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz warns military action against Iran may resume soon, saying Tehran has suffered severe blows throughout the past year.

articles.headline: Rubio warns China after Panama ship detentions, calls hemisphere sovereignty 'non-negotiable'
articles.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio warns hemisphere sovereignty is "non-negotiable" as U.S. and allies condemn China's reported detention of Panama ships.

articles.headline: ‘No credibility’: Obama’s top Iran negotiator torched by State Department after ripping Trump war plan
articles.description: The State Department pushes back on former Obama Iran deal negotiator Wendy Sherman after she criticizes Trump’s strategy, igniting a sharp war of words over Democrats' foreign policy with regime.

articles.headline: Iran’s $800M oil smuggling scheme uses tankers posing as Iraqi ships to dodge blockade
articles.description: Sanctioned tankers are allegedly disguising Iranian oil shipments as Iraqi cargo while Trump doubles down on the naval blockade to squeeze Tehran.

articles.headline: Russia built global recruitment pipeline targeting vulnerable migrants for Ukraine war: report
articles.description: Human rights groups allege Russia recruits tens of thousands of vulnerable migrants from over 130 countries to fight in its ongoing war against Ukraine.

articles.headline: Leaked audio shocker: UK envoy says US ‘special relationship’ not with Britain, but another ally
articles.description: Britain's ambassador to Washington reportedly said America's special relationship is probably with Israel, igniting diplomatic controversy in London.

articles.headline: 2 Jewish men stabbed in London attack classified as terrorism
articles.description: Two men were stabbed in north London's Barnet borough, prompting a counterterrorism-led investigation into a potentially antisemitic incident.

articles.headline: Record antisemitic incidents in Canada fuel criticism of Carney government response
articles.description: Canada faces record antisemitic incidents in 2025 as critics say Prime Minister Mark Carney's government is failing to adequately address anti-Jewish hate.

articles.headline: Court sentences former world leader to 7 years in prison for resisting arrest, other charges
articles.description: Ousted South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol sentenced to seven years in prison after martial law decree that triggered a severe political crisis.

articles.headline: UN-backed data undercuts viral Gaza famine claims as child malnutrition falls
articles.description: United Nations data challenges viral Gaza famine claims as experts say Hamas is weaponizing humanitarian narratives to undermine a post-war coalition.

articles.headline: Tourist dies at luxury resort after cobra from snake show climbs up pants, bites him: police
articles.description: A tourist reportedly died near a luxury all-inclusive resort complex after a venomous cobra slithered up his pants and bit him during a snake show, police said.

articles.headline: New IRA bombing fuels fears of global militant network tied to Iran, Hezbollah
articles.description: The New IRA reportedly claimed a car bomb attack on a Belfast police station, threatening further strikes amid alleged Iran and Hezbollah connections.

articles.headline: Could Narges Mohammadi unite Iran’s opposition? Husband says imprisoned Nobel laureate still fighting
articles.description: Narges Mohammadi's husband says the jailed Nobel Peace Prize laureate was severely beaten during arrest but remains politically unbroken in prison.

articles.headline: 89-year-old man allegedly opens fire with shotgun in Greek capital, injuring 4
articles.description: An 89-year-old man allegedly opened fire inside two Athens government buildings, wounding at least four people in a rare shooting incident in Greece.

articles.headline: US condemns Iran’s leadership role at UN nuclear conference as ‘beyond shameful’
articles.description: The U.S. and allies condemned the U.N.'s decision to grant Iran a vice presidency at the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty review conference in New York.

articles.headline: Can King Charles save the ever-fracturing ‘special relationship’ after Trump anger at Starmer over Iran war?
articles.description: As Britain rejects U.S. blockade tactics against Iran, King Charles III's visit to Washington is shaping up as a critical diplomatic balancing act.

articles.headline: Iran eyes revenge for Soleimani as WHCA Dinner shooting exposes security ‘vulnerability,’ expert warns
articles.description: A former Pentagon intelligence officer claims the White House Correspondents' Association Dinner shooting exposed serious security vulnerabilities around Trump.

articles.headline: Major blow to Putin in Africa as Russian forces driven from Mali stronghold by separatists, jihadists
articles.description: Analysts say Russia's Africa Corps defeat in Mali could be a turning point for Moscow's influence in West Africa as jihadist attacks continue.

articles.headline: Trump admin warns Iraq over Iran terror proxies as US reportedly blocks cash payments
articles.description: The Trump administration reportedly halted dollar shipments to Baghdad to pressure Iraq into disbanding Iran-backed militias that have attacked U.S. personnel.

articles.headline: Death toll from Colombia bus bombing rises to 20 during wave of violence
articles.description: Officials say 20 people died after an explosive device detonated on a bus in southwestern Colombia's Cauca region, injuring 36 others Saturday.

articles.headline: Hormuz crisis spurs $24B Iraq trade corridor as Gulf routes shift
articles.description: Rising Strait of Hormuz tensions fuel Iraq's $24 billion Development Road and other alternative Gulf-to-Europe trade routes, analyst says now.

articles.headline: Iran turmoil erupts: Ultra-hardliner who mocked Trump poised to take over nuclear talks
articles.description: Reports say veteran hardliner Saeed Jalili may replace Ghalibaf on Iran's negotiating team, deepening fractures within the regime's political leadership.

articles.headline: World leaders condemn ‘unacceptable’ violence after armed attack disrupts WH Correspondents’ Dinner
articles.description: Global leaders expressed relief that Trump was unharmed after an armed suspect allegedly attacked the White House Correspondents' Dinner in Washington.

articles.headline: Iran’s good cop, bad cop game implodes as experts warn regime views US as 'evil'
articles.description: Trump canceled planned Iran talks in Pakistan, citing regime infighting, and experts say Tehran's good cop, bad cop negotiating tactic has collapsed.
